title: A move changes only the term, and only for ticked customers
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 15 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly three customers, {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C} (a new term holds only this case's customers), whose names are in that A to Z order, with credit limits of $500.00, $0.00 and $1,000.00.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-16 N15, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-16 Alpha, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-16 Bravo and {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-16 Charlie.
  • {Customer-A} has a phone number, an address and a sales representative set. Customer {Customer-D} holds Net 20.
    For example: {Customer-D} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-16 Delta.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Untick {Customer-C}.
  4. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  5. Click "Move 2 Customers".
  6. Open {Customer-A}'s customer page.
  7. Open {Customer-C}'s customer page.
  8. Open {Customer-D}'s customer page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: "2 selected".
  • Step 4: the button reads "Move 2 Customers".
  • Step 5: the toast "2 customers moved to Net 45." shows.
  • Step 6: the term is Net 45; the phone number, address, sales representative and credit limit are exactly as before.
  • Step 7: {Customer-C} (unticked) is still on {Term-A}, with no new note.
  • Step 8: {Customer-D} is still on Net 20, with no new note.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R18: “Every field other than the credit term (and, under S4-R16, the credit limit) stays as it was on each moved customer.”
  • S4-R19: “Customers not ticked, and customers on other terms, are untouched.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "2 Move customers to another term" ("Some customers unticked"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p2-03-some-customers-unticked.png

The design's own words:

  • “Unticking customers lowers the count ("180 selected") and the button ("Move 180 Customers"). Unticked customers stay on COD.”
